data.value: Before you edit this Game Pass save

data.name: Main_GpCloudSyncWarningMessage
data.value:
IMPORTANT - read this before editing a Game Pass save. Xbox cloud sync treats the cloud copy as the boss, so it can quietly throw your edits away. The ONLY reliable way to make edits stick is to keep the cloud out of it until your edit is done:
1. Fully close Abiotic Factor AND the Xbox app (check the system tray). 2. Disconnect from the internet (Wi-Fi off / airplane mode) - this is the key step. 3. Make your edits here in the editor and SAVE. 4. While STILL offline, launch the game once, load the save, then save in-game and quit. This makes the game itself adopt your edit as the newest copy. 5. Only now reconnect to the internet. If asked, choose Keep local / Upload to cloud.
If you save while online, or pick "download from cloud" at the prompt, the cloud copy wins and your edit is gone. A backup of the whole save folder is made before every write.

data.name: Main_GpMidSyncTitle
data.value: This save needs a quick repair

data.name: Main_GpMidSyncMessage
data.value:
This Game Pass save is looking for a piece of data that is not there, left over from an Xbox sync that never finished. The editor found the real one and used that, which is why the warning keeps coming back. It can tidy this up now so the save is whole again.
IMPORTANT: because that sync never finished, tidying up (and anything you edit afterwards) writes into the Xbox sync folder while it is still in that state, and that is exactly what makes Xbox drop a save later. First fully close Abiotic Factor and the Xbox app. Then go offline (Wi-Fi off or airplane mode) and stay offline through your edits and your save. Only go back online after you have launched the game once offline, loaded the save and saved in game. That makes your version the one Xbox keeps. Either way, the whole save folder is backed up first.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_Office
data.value: Containment breach day. You wake up in the Office Sector, scavenge your first tools, let Dr. Jager into the cafeteria and report to sector security officer Warren.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_Office2
data.value: The only way out is through Manufacturing - but a forklift holding the blast door needs Power Cells. Grayson points you to the energy research team.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_Office3
data.value: You reach the Office Sector's third floor and convince Archie Roberts (or Regal) to open Silo 3, where the Power Cells were taken.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_Flathill
data.value: Silo 3 is open. All signs point through the portal inside: step into Flathill, a fog-drowned suburban anomaly, to recover Power Cells.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_PostFlathill
data.value: You survived Flathill and can now farm Power Cells there. Power the forklift and raise the blast door into Manufacturing.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_MF
data.value: Manufacturing West is open. Somewhere in this sector is a tunnel to the surface - explore and find your way out.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_MFBlacksmith
data.value: You meet the Blacksmith (Varsha), who knows the sector: the Surface Tunnel is the main heavy-traffic route out.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_MFMines
data.value: The Surface Tunnel is blocked. You descend into the mines beneath Manufacturing to find Frake, who may know another way.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_MFFrake
data.value: You found Frake. The plan: get the Blacksmith's help forging parts to repair the sector's three electron pumps.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_MFTrain
data.value: The train station is open, connecting Manufacturing's far reaches while you gather pump materials.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_MFPumpsFixed
data.value: All three electron pumps (yellow, green, red) are repaired. Time to activate the Synchrotron and overload it to blast an exit.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_Pens
data.value: The synchrotron overload opened the way out of Manufacturing. You emerge into Cascade Laboratories through the holding pens.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_Labs
data.value: Explore the Labs Sector for a way out; survivors suggest the Inner Wing containment blocks hold what you need.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_Containment
data.value: You're inside the Inner Wing containment blocks - deadly experiments, turrets, and the route toward the Control Center.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_Helmholtz
data.value: The Helmholtz Wing is open, the path to the Control Center where the security system (and its turrets) can be reset.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_Tarasque
data.value: Via the Furniture Store anomaly you reached the Control Center and reset security - the turrets are off (and the Tarasque met).

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_Mycofields
data.value: The Anteverse 2 portal is fixed: gather chemicals in the Mycofields' Shroom zone to make Antethermite for the Vacuum Chamber door.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_PostLabs
data.value: The vacuum door is breached - you infiltrate the Security Sector, aiming for the Large Surface Elevator, one of the facility's most secure exits.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_SecSurfaceElevator
data.value: The surface elevator crashes catastrophically. Stranded, you explore Canaan for ingredients and open the remaining gates to escape the sector.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_EndSecurity
data.value: The Security Sector exit is open; there's only one way forward - down into the Hydroplant.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_ElectricalStation
data.value: You reach the central dam. Survivors in the Electrical Station (Jonas) can help - reactivate the station, reboot the spillway computer, and open the flow controls.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_Voussoir
data.value: You step through to Voussoir, the drowned cathedral anteverse reachable from the Hydroplant.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_EndDam
data.value: The spillway is open. The only way out of the Hydroplant is wet: ride the water down toward the Reactors.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_PowerServices
data.value: You enter Power Services. A massive fungal bloom blocks the way to the Reactors - you need something to kill it.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_AnteverseC
data.value: You enter Anteverse C (the Far Garden) to gather what's needed for Anti-Fungal Gelatin.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_ReactorsEntry
data.value: The bloom is destroyed and the way into the Reactor Sector is open - you hope that was the right thing to do.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_Reactors1Labs
data.value: First contact in the Deep Field labs: Dr. Cahn explains the Gatekeeper's exit waygate needs four reactors online. Activate Dusk Reactor and report back.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_ReactorsAll
data.value: The S1 labs are searched (Cloud Reactor explored). Now bring Gale, Mist and Cloud Reactors online to join Dusk.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_Shadowgate
data.value: All four reactors power the Fusion Generator's central waygate: the Shadowgate. Inside the mirrored Intrados facility, destroy the five containment devices and expel the entity.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_InqEnd
data.value: The creature fled through a massive rift. Beyond it lies somewhere immense and old - with Hasta's guidance, enter the Praetorium (IS-0101) and locate the Sun Disk.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_Residence
data.value: The Sun Disk's gift lets you endure the cold at last: enter the frozen Residence Sector.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_Residence2
data.value: With Abe and Janet's help the storm suppressor is fixed; the upper floor is searchable, but a frozen ice wall bars the way ahead.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_Fracture
data.value: An intense heat source melted the ice wall - you push into the Fracture, hunting the Dark Lens that can get everyone out.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_Botanical
data.value: You enter the Botanical Gardens, the overgrown heart of the Residence Sector's upper reaches.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_DarkLens
data.value: Past the wall lies the Dark Lens. Collect its fragments, face The Fallow, and open the way out of the facility at last.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_SouthIsland
data.value: The Fracture is behind you: you arrive at the South Island, whose altar can supposedly take you anywhere - Dr. Cahn and Thule have thoughts.

data.name: WorldStory_ChapterSummary_EndGame
data.value: The Wayseeker is defeated. The end? Talk to Dr. Cahn, Janet, and the Sister of the Unlost. Main story complete.

data.name: WorldTraders_Lore_Warren_Blurb
data.value: Sydney-sider turned subterranean security specialist. Sells security keys, seeds, alloys and repair kits; stock grows with story progress.

data.name: WorldTraders_Lore_Warren_Unlock

data.name: WorldTraders_Lore_Grayson_Unlock

data.name: WorldTraders_Lore_Blacksmith_Blurb

data.name: WorldTraders_Lore_Blacksmith_Unlock
data.value: Available once you reach the F.O.R.G.E. in Manufacturing West.

data.name: WorldTraders_Lore_Marion_Where
data.value: Flathill (Rewind Rentals); later travels near Cacophonous Crates

data.name: WorldTraders_Lore_Marion_Blurb
data.value: One of the last denizens of Flathill - an Acolyte who worships the Composers. Trades dampeners, hoses, porcelain keys and an antique shotgun.

data.name: WorldTraders_Lore_Marion_Unlock
data.value: Opens shop after you reach Flathill and meet her at Rewind Rentals.

data.name: WorldTraders_Lore_Chef_Where
data.value: Security Sector garage; later travels to kitchen areas

data.name: WorldTraders_Lore_Chef_Blurb
data.value: Self-proclaimed Culinarian of the Containment Division. Trades cooking gear, seeds, ingredients and beverages.

data.name: WorldTraders_Lore_Chef_Unlock
data.value: Becomes a trader after you meet him in the Security Sector garage.

data.name: WorldTraders_Lore_Jimmy_Where
data.value: First met in the Botanical Garden / Botanical Wing

data.name: WorldTraders_Lore_Jimmy_Blurb
data.value: Young New Zealander who took a Taco Mine job in 1992 without asking questions. Trades tacos and fast-food cosmetics.

data.name: WorldTraders_Lore_Jimmy_Unlock

data.name: WorldTraders_Lore_Thule_Blurb

data.name: WorldTraders_Lore_Thule_Unlock
